description:
You are a Management Analyst at a manufacturing firm conducting a business process improvement project. You need to document the company's Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) business process as a swim lane flowchart for a process audit. The process specification is at ~/Desktop/p2p_process_spec.txt.

Create a complete swim lane process diagram in draw.io with exactly 5 horizontal lanes corresponding to the 5 departments described in the spec: (1) Requester, (2) Procurement, (3) Accounts Payable, (4) Supplier, (5) Finance/Treasury.

The diagram must include ALL of the following process elements:
- At least 12 process steps (rounded rectangles) placed in their correct department lane
- At least 3 decision diamonds (gateways) — one for budget approval, one for 3-way matching, one for payment approval
- At least 2 parallel flow branches (shown with split/join shapes or fork lines)
- At least 1 exception/rejection path looping back to a previous step
- Data objects (documents) shown as folded-page shapes attached to key steps (at minimum: Purchase Requisition, Purchase Order, Goods Receipt, Invoice)
- Proper flow direction: left-to-right OR top-to-bottom
- A Start event and End event

Add a second page titled 'KPI Dashboard' that lists at least 5 Key Performance Indicators for the P2P process as a table or structured diagram (cycle time, first-pass match rate, PO compliance %, etc.).

Save as ~/Desktop/p2p_process.drawio and export as ~/Desktop/p2p_process.pdf (use File > Export As > PDF).
